design_overview: StudyCircle is a clean, card-based student app with indigo branding. Bottom navigation connects notes, groups and profile, and core flows (upload, join, report) take three taps or fewer.

screens.name: Sign Up
screens.purpose: Register with a university email and trigger verification so only verified students join.

key_components.name: Welcome Header
key_components.styling: Indigo gradient header with app logo and title 'Join StudyCircle', white text, rounded bottom corners.
key_components.interaction: Static; scrolls away with content.

key_components.name: Full Name Input
key_components.styling: 52px rounded field, light border, placeholder 'Full name', user icon at left.
key_components.interaction: Tap to type; validates on blur.

key_components.name: University Email Input
key_components.styling: 52px rounded field, placeholder 'name@university.edu', helper text 'Use your university email'.
key_components.interaction: Validates university domain; shows inline error in red.

key_components.name: Password Input
key_components.styling: 52px rounded field, placeholder 'Create password (8+ characters)', show/hide toggle at right.
key_components.interaction: Tap toggle to reveal; strength bar updates while typing.

key_components.name: Major Dropdown
key_components.styling: Rounded select field, placeholder 'Select your major', chevron at right.
key_components.interaction: Opens searchable major list sheet.

key_components.name: Terms Checkbox
key_components.styling: Indigo checkbox with text 'I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy' and underlined links.
key_components.interaction: Toggles; required to enable Create Account.

key_components.name: Create Account Button
key_components.styling: Full-width 52px indigo gradient button, white bold label 'Create Account', soft shadow.
key_components.interaction: Submits form; opens Verification Sent state then Notes Library.

key_components.name: Verification Banner
key_components.styling: Success-tinted card: 'Verification email sent. Check your inbox.' with 'Resend' text link.
key_components.interaction: Resend link sends another email; 'Open app' continues to Notes Library.

key_components.name: Log In Link
key_components.styling: Text button 'Already have an account? Log in' in indigo.
key_components.interaction: Opens login form with email and password.

screens.user_flow: Launch app, then Sign Up, then verification email, then Notes Library. Existing users tap Log In.

screens.name: Notes Library
screens.purpose: Browse, search, filter and rate shared study notes by course and topic.

key_components.name: Top App Bar
key_components.styling: White bar with title 'Notes' and bell icon with red unread badge.
key_components.interaction: Bell opens notifications panel listing recent group activity.

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: Rounded pill field, placeholder 'Search notes, courses, topics', search icon at left, light shadow.
key_components.interaction: Typing returns live matching notes in under one second.

key_components.name: Filter Button
key_components.styling: Square outlined button beside search; indigo dot shows active filters.
key_components.interaction: Opens filter sheet: course, topic, file type, sort.

key_components.name: Course Chips
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrolling chips: 'All', 'CS 101', 'MATH 201', 'BIO 110'; selected chip filled indigo.
key_components.interaction: Tap to filter notes by course.

key_components.name: Sort Toggle
key_components.styling: Segmented control with 'Relevance' and 'Top Rated', active segment white with shadow.
key_components.interaction: Re-sorts the results list.

key_components.name: Note Card List
key_components.styling: Cards with PDF thumbnail, title, 'CS 101 · Sorting Algorithms', uploader, star rating 4.7, file size.
key_components.interaction: Tap card to open note preview with download and rating.

key_components.name: Bookmark Action
key_components.styling: Icon button at card top-right; outline when unsaved, filled indigo when saved.
key_components.interaction: Toggles saved state with brief toast 'Saved to bookmarks'.

key_components.name: Note Overflow Report
key_components.styling: Small share icon button on each card, paired with a text link 'Report' in muted gray.
key_components.interaction: Share copies link; Report opens report reason sheet.

key_components.name: Upload Floating Button
key_components.styling: 56px round indigo floating button with white plus icon, raised shadow, above the nav bar.
key_components.interaction: Opens Upload Note screen.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with 4 tabs: Notes, Upload, Groups, Profile; active tab indigo with label.
key_components.interaction: Tap switches tab; Notes is active here.

screens.user_flow: Reached after login or via the Notes tab. Leaves to Upload Note, a note preview, or other tabs.

screens.name: Upload Note
screens.purpose: Publish a PDF or image note with a title, course and topic in a few taps.

key_components.name: Upload Header
key_components.styling: White bar with back arrow and title 'Upload Note'.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Notes Library; unsaved changes prompt confirmation.

key_components.name: File Drop Zone
key_components.styling: Dashed indigo border card, plus icon, text 'Tap to choose PDF or image', hint 'Max 20 MB'.
key_components.interaction: Opens file picker; shows file name and progress bar after selection.

key_components.name: File Preview Row
key_components.styling: Row with thumbnail, 'week3_notes.pdf', '4.2 MB', green 'Scanned' badge and remove icon.
key_components.interaction: Trash icon removes the selected file.

key_components.name: Title Input
key_components.styling: 52px rounded field, placeholder 'Note title, e.g. Week 3 Sorting Summary'.
key_components.interaction: Required; shows error if empty on publish.

key_components.name: Course Select
key_components.styling: Rounded select with placeholder 'Select course', chevron at right.
key_components.interaction: Opens searchable course list from user's profile courses.

key_components.name: Topic Input
key_components.styling: Rounded field with placeholder 'Add topic tags (e.g. Recursion)', tags shown as removable chips.
key_components.interaction: Enter adds a tag chip.

key_components.name: Description Input
key_components.styling: Multi-line rounded field, placeholder 'What does this note cover? (optional)'.
key_components.interaction: Expands to fit text up to 4 lines.

key_components.name: Error and Size Hint
key_components.styling: Red inline text 'File exceeds 20 MB. Choose a smaller file.' shown only on invalid files.
key_components.interaction: Dismisses when a valid file is chosen.

key_components.name: Publish Button
key_components.styling: Full-width indigo gradient button 'Publish Note', disabled gray until file, title and course are set.
key_components.interaction: Uploads, scans and publishes; returns to Notes Library with success toast.

key_components.name: Cancel Button
key_components.styling: Outlined secondary button 'Cancel' under Publish, gray text.
key_components.interaction: Discards draft and returns to Notes Library.

screens.user_flow: Tap plus on Notes Library, then choose file, fill title and course, then Publish. Returns to Notes Library showing the new note.

screens.name: Study Groups
screens.purpose: Discover, join and create course study groups, and let admins approve member requests.

key_components.name: Groups Header
key_components.styling: White bar titled 'Study Groups' with bell icon and badge.
key_components.interaction: Bell opens notifications panel.

key_components.name: Group Search Input
key_components.styling: Rounded pill field, placeholder 'Search groups by course or name', search icon at left.
key_components.interaction: Filters discover list as you type.

key_components.name: Tab Switcher
key_components.styling: Segmented tabs 'My Groups' and 'Discover', active tab indigo underline.
key_components.interaction: Switches the list shown below.

key_components.name: My Group Cards
key_components.styling: Cards with group avatar, 'Algorithms Crew', 'CS 101 · 12 members', unread count pill in indigo.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens Group Feed for that group.

key_components.name: Discover Group Card
key_components.styling: Card with course tag 'MATH 201', name, member count, 'Private' badge and trailing 'Join' button.
key_components.interaction: Public: joins instantly. Private: sends request and button reads 'Requested'.

key_components.name: Join Requests Card
key_components.styling: Admin-only warning-tinted card 'Join requests (3)' with avatar, name 'Maya R.', 'Approve' and 'Reject' buttons.
key_components.interaction: Approve adds member; Reject removes request; both show toast.

key_components.name: Manage Members Row
key_components.styling: Admin list of members with role label and red text button 'Remove' on each row.
key_components.interaction: Remove asks confirmation, then removes member from group.

key_components.name: Create Group Button
key_components.styling: Indigo floating pill button 'Create Group' with white plus icon above bottom nav.
key_components.interaction: Opens Create Group sheet: name, course, privacy toggle, 'Create' button.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with 4 tabs; Groups tab active in indigo.
key_components.interaction: Tap switches tab.

screens.user_flow: Reached via the Groups tab. Join or create a group, then open it to reach Group Feed. Admins manage requests here.

screens.name: Group Feed
screens.purpose: Chat and discuss within a group, attach notes, receive notifications, and report inappropriate posts.

key_components.name: Group Header
key_components.styling: Indigo gradient bar with back arrow, 'Algorithms Crew', subtitle 'CS 101 · 12 members', bell icon.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Study Groups; title opens group details.

key_components.name: Notification Toggle
key_components.styling: Strip below header: 'Notify me of new posts' with indigo switch.
key_components.interaction: Toggles in-app notifications for this group.

key_components.name: Pinned Note Card
key_components.styling: Soft indigo card with PDF thumbnail, 'Midterm Cheat Sheet', 4.8 rating and 'Open' link.
key_components.interaction: Opens note preview.

key_components.name: Message Feed
key_components.styling: Chat bubbles with avatar, name, time; own messages indigo right-aligned, others white left-aligned.
key_components.interaction: Scrolls; new posts appear within 5 seconds.

key_components.name: Attached Note Bubble
key_components.styling: Bubble containing mini note card with title, course tag and 'View note' button.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens note preview.

key_components.name: Reaction Button
key_components.styling: Small heart icon with count under each message, filled red when liked.
key_components.interaction: Toggles like on the message.

key_components.name: Report Post Action
key_components.styling: Muted text link 'Report' under messages from others.
key_components.interaction: Opens report sheet.

key_components.name: Report Sheet
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet 'Report content' with radio reasons, a details input 'Add details (optional)' and red 'Submit Report'.
key_components.interaction: Submit queues report for moderators and shows toast 'Report sent'.

key_components.name: Message Composer
key_components.styling: Rounded input 'Write a message...' with plus attach button at left and indigo send button at right.
key_components.interaction: Send posts the message; plus opens note picker to attach a note.

screens.user_flow: Open a group from Study Groups, read and post messages, attach notes, report content. Back returns to Study Groups.

screens.name: Profile and Moderation
screens.purpose: Edit public profile with major and courses; moderators review reported content and remove it.

key_components.name: Profile Header
key_components.styling: Indigo gradient header with round avatar, name 'Alex Johnson', 'Computer Science · Verified', settings icon.
key_components.interaction: Settings icon opens account settings and data deletion request.

key_components.name: Edit Name Input
key_components.styling: Rounded field prefilled 'Alex Johnson' with edit icon, placeholder 'Display name'.
key_components.interaction: Tap to edit; changes enable Save button.

key_components.name: Major Select
key_components.styling: Rounded select showing 'Computer Science', placeholder 'Select your major', chevron at right.
key_components.interaction: Opens major list sheet.

key_components.name: Courses Chips Input
key_components.styling: Chip field with removable chips 'CS 101', 'MATH 201' and placeholder 'Add a course'.
key_components.interaction: Typing suggests courses; tap adds chip.

key_components.name: My Notes Summary
key_components.styling: White card with stats: '8 notes uploaded', '4.6 avg rating', chevron suggesting navigation.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens list of my uploaded notes in Notes Library.

key_components.name: Save Profile Button
key_components.styling: Full-width indigo button 'Save Changes', disabled until edits are made.
key_components.interaction: Saves and updates public profile immediately with success toast.

key_components.name: Moderation Queue List
key_components.styling: Moderator-only section 'Pending Reports (5)'; cards show content preview, reason, reporter and age.
key_components.interaction: Tap a report to expand full content details.

key_components.name: Remove Content Button
key_components.styling: Red filled button 'Remove Content' beside outlined 'Dismiss' on each report card.
key_components.interaction: Hides content, notifies uploader, and clears report from queue.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with 4 tabs; Profile tab active in indigo.
key_components.interaction: Tap switches tab.

screens.user_flow: Reached via the Profile tab. Edit and save profile; moderators review the report queue. Leaves via bottom navigation.

ui_components.name: Primary Button
ui_components.styling: 52px tall, indigo gradient, white semibold label, 12px radius, soft shadow, pressed state darker.
ui_components.interaction: Triggers main screen action; shows loading spinner while processing.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: Outlined 1px indigo border, white fill, indigo label, 12px radius.

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: 52px, white fill, 1px gray border, 12px radius, indigo focus ring, red border on error.
ui_components.interaction: Tap to type; inline validation message.

ui_components.name: Note Card
ui_components.styling: White card, 16px radius, soft shadow, thumbnail left, title, course tag, rating and bookmark.

ui_components.name: Group Card
ui_components.styling: White card with avatar, group name, course tag, member count and trailing action button.
ui_components.interaction: Tap opens group; button joins or requests.

ui_components.name: Filter Chip
ui_components.styling: 32px pill, light gray fill; selected state indigo fill with white text.

ui_components.name: Message Bubble
ui_components.styling: 16px radius bubble; own indigo with white text, others white with border; timestamp in small gray.
ui_components.interaction: Long press shows like and report options.

ui_components.name: Bottom Sheet
ui_components.styling: White sheet with 24px top radius, drag handle and dimmed backdrop.
ui_components.interaction: Swipe down or tap backdrop to dismiss.

ui_components.name: Toast
ui_components.styling: Dark rounded pill above nav bar with white text; green accent for success, red for errors.

ui_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
ui_components.styling: 64px white bar, top hairline border, 4 tabs with icons and labels, active tab indigo.

responsive_design: Mobile-first single column with bottom nav under 768px. On tablet and desktop, bottom nav becomes a left sidebar and note cards form a 2-3 column grid.
accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, 44px minimum touch targets, visible focus rings, labels on all inputs, alt text for thumbnails, screen-reader labels on icon buttons, error text not color-only.
animations: 150-250ms ease-out transitions: slide-in screens, bottom sheet slide-up, button press scale 0.97, toast fade, new message slide-in, heart pop.
icons: Outline icon set only, 24px: home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash, share. No emojis; the active state is filled indigo.
